test_cases.name: happy_path_full_contract_fulfillment
test_cases.description: Full contract fulfillment when preconditions, baseline invariants, operation, postconditions, and post-execution invariants all pass.
test_cases.input: Execute operation write_config under contract dbc-write-cfg with valid JSON payload and clean workspace.
expected_output_patterns: === CONTRACT EVALUATION INITIALIZED: dbc-write-cfg Op: write_config ===
=== CONTRACT FULFILLED: dbc-write-cfg Op: write_config Status: CERTIFIED ===

test_cases.name: precondition_failure_fail_fast
test_cases.description: Fail-fast abort when a precondition evaluates to FALSE. Target operation must not execute, and DbcDefectReport must be emitted.
test_cases.input: Execute operation write_config under contract dbc-write-cfg where target directory does not exist.
expected_output_patterns: === CONTRACT EVALUATION INITIALIZED: dbc-write-cfg Op: write_config ===

test_cases.name: operation_execution_error
test_cases.description: Operation throws an unhandled runtime error during execution, causing state transition to OPERATION_FAILED and halting pipeline.
test_cases.input: Execute operation db_migrate under contract dbc-db-migrate where migration script raises database connection error.
expected_output_patterns: === CONTRACT EVALUATION INITIALIZED: dbc-db-migrate Op: db_migrate ===

test_cases.name: postcondition_failure_rollback
test_cases.description: Operation completes but output fails postcondition validation, triggering compensating rollback and emitting POSTCONDITION_FAILED.
test_cases.input: Execute operation generate_report under contract dbc-gen-rep where output file is generated but is empty (0 bytes).
expected_output_patterns: === CONTRACT EVALUATION INITIALIZED: dbc-gen-rep Op: generate_report ===

test_cases.name: invariant_violation_quarantine
test_cases.description: Operation completes and postconditions pass, but workspace invariant is violated, triggering emergency rollback and halting certification.
test_cases.input: Execute operation batch_cleanup under contract dbc-batch-clean where protected file permissions or configuration was mutated.
expected_output_patterns: === CONTRACT EVALUATION INITIALIZED: dbc-batch-clean Op: batch_cleanup ===

test_cases.name: uncontracted_operation_detection
test_cases.description: Attempting to execute an operation requiring formal gates without registering a valid ContractDefinition halts with UNCONTRACTED_OPERATION_DETECTED.
test_cases.input: Attempt protected deployment operation deploy_service with missing or unregistered contract definition.
